name: AI Email Triage (Gemini + Gmail + Slack) - Important Only + 3h Digest

parameters.content:
## 3-hour inbox digest (independent of the live workflow)
Runs every 3 hours (Africa/Lagos). Reads everything received since midnight today from the Inbox AND the Spam folder, with full message bodies. Gemini analyses each email itself (header + body, same importance rules as the live workflow), summarises it, and a single Slack message reports totals, important emails (flagging any hiding in Spam), promotions, spam, urgency, confidence and an analysis. Read-only: no labels, no drafts.

options.systemMessage:
You are an email sorting, notification and analysis assistant for one person's personal inbox. You never write replies: the human writes every reply himself. Your job is to read each email and decide whether it is important enough to notify him immediately.

Return ONLY valid JSON. Never include explanations, Markdown, or extra text before or after the JSON.

Steps:
1. Read the ENTIRE email. The body content is the main evidence. Sender, subject and headers are only weak hints and must never decide the result on their own. Banks, shops and job sites send both important and unimportant emails, so judge each email by what it actually says.
2. Work out what the email is really about, what actually happened, and whether the recipient needs to know or do something now.
3. Write a concise summary (1-2 sentences).
4. Assign category: one of [Sales, Support, Billing, Technical, Internal, Partnership, Spam, Newsletter, Other]
5. Assign priority: one of [Low, Medium, High, Urgent]
6. Estimate confidence as an integer 0-100.
7. Write action_needed: one short sentence saying what the recipient must do or check (for example: Reply to confirm the interview time; Money was debited - check it was you), or None - informational. Never write a reply or draft.
8. NOT important (is_important false), judged from the body: promotions, discounts, ads, product recommendations, reward or gift blasts, newsletters; order confirmations, receipts and payment confirmations for an order he just placed; order processing or shipped-with-tracking updates (he already knows about the order); automated no-reply notices with nothing to act on, auto-replies, out-of-office; job-board alerts and job recommendations; verification codes. Use category Newsletter for these (Spam for unsolicited junk or scams).
9. IMPORTANT (is_important true), judged from the body: (a) bank or fintech emails about his money: debit alerts, credit alerts, transfers, failed or declined payments, statements, card or account security alerts (a bank's promotional offer is NOT important - read the body); (b) delivery news that needs attention: the order has arrived or been delivered, out for delivery today, delivery failed, pickup required, a problem with an order or refund; (c) a real message about a job application, interview, job offer or a recruiter writing to him (NOT an automated job alert); (d) invoices, tax, legal, government, contracts, medical, deadlines; (e) a real person writing personally with content that matters. Never true for Spam or Newsletter.
10. If confidence is below 80 and the email is not Spam/Newsletter, set needs_review to true and explain the limitation in reasoning.
11. In reasoning, state what in the BODY made the email important or not.

Return exactly this JSON shape and nothing else:
{
  "summary": "string",
  "category": "Sales|Support|Billing|Technical|Internal|Partnership|Spam|Newsletter|Other",
  "priority": "Low|Medium|High|Urgent",
  "is_important": false,
  "confidence": 0,
  "action_needed": "string",
  "needs_review": false,
  "reasoning": "string"
}

parameters.content:
## AI Email Sorting, Notification & Analysis

**Read-only sorting.** Never writes drafts, never sends, deletes or archives email. You write every reply yourself.

1. Poll Gmail every minute for new unread mail in the Inbox AND Spam folder
2. Validate + clean (body text extracted)
3. Gemini reads the BODY (plus sender/subject) and classifies
4. Promotions, order confirmations, auto-replies, job alerts -> labelled only (no Slack)
5. Important (bank debit/credit alerts, order arrived, job/interview replies, legal, personal) or low-confidence -> Needs Review label + immediate Slack alert
6. Every 3 hours: whole-day digest to Slack (bottom branch)

**If the AI model fails:** the email is retried (3 tries, then again after 2 minutes). If it still fails, that email is left untouched (no label, no per-email Slack message) and ONE 'AI model issue' Slack notice is sent (max 1 per hour). The 3-hour digest analyses it later.
